text.en: Boarding clients emphasize how well pets are looked after, noting dogs and cats receive ample cuddles, kindness, and individual attention. Dogs are given one-to-one exercise sessions so they are never mixed with unfamiliar animals. Pet owners describe feeling complete peace of mind knowing their animals are safe and content.

Reviewers praise the peaceful countryside setting and bright, well-ventilated kennels and cattery accommodation. Visitors highlight floor-to-ceiling windows with scenic outdoor views, as well as underfloor heating during colder months. The units are routinely disinfected between stays, maintaining high standards of cleanliness.

Pet owners commend Linda, Brianne, and the team for being welcoming, warm, and helpful from arrival to collection. Clients appreciate receiving photo updates while away, which helps reassure them during their travels. Several reviewers mention booking repeat stays over multiple years due to the team's dedicated approach.

q.en: Can both cats and dogs be boarded at Hedgerow?

a.en: Yes, the facility accommodates both cats and dogs with dedicated cattery and kennel facilities.

q.en: Do dogs get separate individual exercise time?

a.en: Reviewers note that dogs are let out for one-to-one exercise sessions in an enclosed area rather than being mixed with unfamiliar dogs.

q.en: What heating and comfort amenities are provided in the boarding units?

a.en: Pet owners highlight underfloor heating for winter stays as well as bright, airy accommodation with views outdoors.

q.en: Do staff send updates and photos while pets are boarding?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate that the staff send photo updates to give owners peace of mind while away.
